Рецепт принятых h1…h5 (heroes-set1.json): тот же стиль, кадр и три референса стиля из art/style. Кадр уточнён: по пояс, без ног, корпус развёрнут вправо — к врагам. Редкость не рисуем, класс — по оружию или предмету, школа — по цвету свечения. У зверицы c2-69 без ref-04: на нём зверь, модель перерисовала бы его
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; exactly two arms and two hands.

heroes.frame: Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. Half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

Keep the picture exactly as it is — the same dwarf, his pose, face, half-closed eyes, beard, leather cap, jerkin, belt, the hand on his chest, the timber shield, the broken props, the rubble, the crystals, the light and the painting style. Change only this: his skin is painted flat grey like stone, which is a mistake — give his face, arms and hands the natural warm, ruddy skin tone of a living dwarf, only lightly powdered with grey rock dust on the forehead, cheeks and forearms. Nothing else changes.
jobs.subject_v2: Subject: Haldur Under the Rubble, a dwarf miner, a tank of the Earth school who can also heal himself; in the year the earth shook he lay buried under a rockfall for five days and survived by breathing slowly and counting. Close half-body portrait: the picture is cut at his belt, and his head and broad shoulders fill the upper half of the frame — dwarves are short, so the camera comes close; no legs and no boots are visible. A dwarf of middle age, grey with rock dust from head to toe, a ragged dark-brown beard, a bruised, calm face, eyes half-closed as he breathes slowly, his right hand pressed flat on his chest. A torn miner's jerkin and a leather cap. On his left arm a heavy shield made of a thick slab of mine-prop timber bound with iron bands, scarred by falling rock, raised to shoulder height. Background: a collapsed tunnel deep in a dwarven mine: broken timber props and a cracked, sagging beam above him, heaps of fallen rock, dust hanging in thin shafts of light. Warm amber light of the Earth school glows from the cracks in the rubble below and softly around his chest as he breathes.

jobs.subject: Subject: Kaelin, an elven man, a healer of the Air school who also weakens foes; he came to the dwarven mountain with a caravan of elven remedies and taught the miners to breathe in bad air, and he lived thirty years among the dwarves, a stranger they needed. A tall slender elven man who looks about forty by human measure, a calm gentle face, long straight dark-auburn hair tied back, pointed ears, quiet eyes. A travelling healer's coat of muted sage green, a bandolier of small glass vials with pale green infusions across his chest, a cloth breathing mask lowered around his neck. His left hand rests on his chest; his right hand is raised, palm up, and he breathes out slowly: a stream of clean white-green air flows from his palm and pushes back the heavy haze. Background: a lower tunnel of a dwarven mine full of heavy, murky, yellow-grey air, pit props, dim miners' lamps. Pale white-green light of the Air school rises from below and surrounds him with clear air; dust hangs in the murk beyond.

jobs.subject: Subject: Gorm the Torchbearer, a dwarf, a tank of the Fire school, guardian of the deepest hall of the dwarven mountain, where the dead are stood in niches facing their work; on the night the dead stepped out of the niches he took up a torch, though for a dwarf fire near the dead is a disgrace. A dwarf in his fifties, broad and grim, a copper-red beard in two heavy braids streaked with soot, a heavy brow, eyes full of grief and resolve. Dark iron armour and a guardian's heavy cloak. On his left arm a tall dark iron shield; in his raised right hand a blazing torch, scarlet flames streaming. Background: a vast, deep, ancient hall: rows of tall niches carved in the walls, the nearest niches blackened and scorched by fire, the others lost in darkness, nothing visible inside them; behind him a narrow archway that he guards. Scarlet-red light of the Fire school from the torch and from embers on the floor below, smoke and sparks in the air.

jobs.subject: Subject: She Who Leaves, a sentient beast, a swift hunter of the Air school who knocks her foes off their feet: an old grey she-beast of the dangerous stony lands at the foot of the dwarven mountain; for forty years she escaped every net of the dwarven trappers, and she drank only rainwater from the rocks, so she stayed herself. She is a great grey mountain lynx, larger than a wolf, with smoky grey fur faintly marked with darker spots, long black ear tufts, a grizzled muzzle, a notch torn in one ear, and wise, calm pale-gold eyes of a thinking creature. For this beast the half-body frame shows her head, chest and forelegs resting on a rock; her hindquarters are out of the frame. She is turned toward the right side of the picture, alert, about to leave. White-green wind of the Air school swirls around her paws and lifts her fur. Background: a grey stony wasteland under a rainy dusk sky, a hollow in the rock holding clear rainwater, an old hemp net cut through and left snagged on the rocks, the dark mass of a mountain far behind. Pale white-green light of the Air school rises from the rainwater and the wet stones below.
